title: The Poachers
text: Poachers have trapped the quarry in a pit and netted it, and it thrashes there, bleeding from the stakes. They mean to sell it alive to someone who pays well for such things. They do not say who. They grin at you over their crossbows.

options.label: Buy the quarry from them, so it is yours to hunt and not theirs to sell.

outcomes.text: A fair price, and then they cut it loose on you, and it is a fair fight.

options.label: Drive the poachers off. This hunt is yours.

outcomes.text: They fight. The quarry tears free in the chaos and is gone.

options.label: The gentlest frees the beast, whatever it might do once loose.

outcomes.text: It does not attack. It watches a long moment, and goes, and the way it goes is shorter.
